name: Four Candles for the Dead
source:
Four Candles for the Dead is a love letter to the sexy, violent anime of the '80s. A blend of Neo-Giallo, hard-boiled detective stories and waifus. Introducing Freelance Detective, Lydia Knight in her first short story. 

[From [url=https://mutantvision.itch.io/four-candles-for-the-dead]itch.io[/url]]
